discipline_notes_for_whoever_resumes: never replace a pinned product source file outside the install pipeline; it stops the gateway
every authority must be rebuilt with the live gateway pid and start_time after any restart
run ids must match the pinned names exactly, including the dash before the attempt number
a run that closes with no reply may still be a late completion: check the captured updates for a reply_to pointing at the sent message before calling it a loss
independent_work_that_can_continue_witho: TIFF ingestion diagnosis, which needs one live TIFF send plus instrumentation inside the gateway
format backend checks in the PM environment, which the tester cannot drive
any clean multi-part sequence, which needs a fresh conversation

the_single_decision_needed.question: authorise a drain-and-replace: stop the Friday gateway, install the 184-layer composition into a new runtime home, switch the unit to it, and keep the current home for rollback
the_single_decision_needed.risk: a few minutes of downtime and a changed runtime home; the previous home stays intact for an immediate rollback
the_single_decision_needed.what_is_ready: candidate tree, receipt, restored bundle, regenerated inventory, rollback copy of the five differing files and of the old receipt
the_single_decision_needed.why_it_is_needed: every other route is closed by design, not by permission: direct file swap fails the three-way binding, and an edited installer input fails the foreign-install check

format_volume_scope.what_is_needed: a decision on whether the format volume belongs to this release and, if so, authorisation to build the driven-operation check on top of the existing tools rather than a new framework
format_volume_scope.why: all 120 format extensions are NOT_RUN with backend NOT_VERIFIED and capability UNASSESSED; the tester can send a document but cannot drive create, edit or extract per extension

install_authority.what_is_needed: either a manifested overlay authored through the install pipeline, or explicit authorisation to re-issue the source receipt through scripts/hermes_prepare.py and scripts/friday_install.py
install_authority.what_unlocks: the prepared write_file format guard, the TIFF ingress fix once its condition is identified, and any compression repair
install_authority.why: the product pins more than a thousand source files in hermes-agent.source.json, so any repaired file stops the gateway with friday_dashboard_owner_unproved; I proved that the hard way and rolled it back

one_fresh_conversation.who_can_do_it: the owner, by starting a new conversation at a moment of their choosing; I must not clear the live chat myself
one_fresh_conversation.why: every remaining B00 step is a continuation or a recall, and the documents and answers it depends on are already in the live chat; running them there produces contaminated answers, as D-03 showed today

what_changed_since_first_block.bundle: the authoritative 184-layer bundle was found, three data defects were repaired, and it is restored in the repository; composition from ROOT now succeeds
what_changed_since_first_block.candidate: a candidate with the write_file guard and the three source157 context layers composes with a valid receipt: 184 overlays, 17888 files
what_changed_since_first_block.consequence: delivering the repairs means a new runtime home and a service switchover with the same Telegram token, which needs a coordinated stop of the current gateway and an owner-accepted downtime window
what_changed_since_first_block.install_path: in-place update is architecturally unsupported: friday_install.install() requires the marker input_sha256 to equal the input being installed, and a new generation starts only when the home does not exist

what_is_ready_the_moment_a_decision_land.d03_rerun: authority R28 is already built and admitted; the run ids and scenario hashes are pinned
what_is_ready_the_moment_a_decision_land.tiff_probe: instrument one TIFF ingestion in gateway/run_inbound_media.py and record which custody condition fires; read-only, no behaviour change

write_file_fix.verified: in an isolated namespace: a bad format returns unsupported_format with the allowed list and never reaches scoped_file; the text format path is unchanged
